post.description: Copies or moves (`actions=copy|move`) a file/directory from `path` to `destiny`. Proxied to the worker. Requires `instance:files:write`. Worker communication failures return 503 before the response starts. A timeout does not confirm failure of the operation: check its resulting state before retrying. No automatic retry is performed. WORKER_TIMEOUT (default 300000 ms) covers the request and JSON response consumption. Unused control-command response bodies are cancelled; this deadline does not limit asynchronous game operations. Symbolic links in the requested source or destination path are rejected with 403, including intermediate directories. Moving the instance root is rejected with 400.
